# OnEggy Technologies

OnEggy Technologies is a modern cloud-native engineering partner specializing in AWS Cloud, Kubernetes infrastructure orchestration, DevOps automation, and high-performance digital applications.

## Core Services
- AWS Cloud Managed Services (https://www.oneggy.com/services/aws-cloud-managed-services)
- Kubernetes Setup & Orchestration (https://www.oneggy.com/services/kubernetes)
- DevOps Consulting & Automation (https://www.oneggy.com/services/devops-consulting)
- Platform Engineering (https://www.oneggy.com/services/platform-engineering)
- Full Stack & Mobile App Development (https://www.oneggy.com/services/full-stack-web-development)
